extra_sections.heading: Attic Survey
extra_sections.body: The attic annex holds rolled charts from three previous decades, stacked by colour along the east wall. Dust covers every shelf except the one Bricky uses as a standing desk. A brass lamp hums over the reading chair, and a cracked window feeds the room a stripe of cold light. Nothing here was catalogued after the flood; the survey marks what survived, where it rests, and which boxes still smell of river water. Two cabinets remain locked. The surveyor left them sealed, pending a decision no one has yet made.
